g.title: j1085648573
g.text: You keep calling me "Usurper." Yet you're the one who was trying to overthrow the Orokin Empire.

g.title: j2604704401
g.text: Roathe, why do you keep calling me "Usurper?"

g.title: j606463827
g.text: You keep calling me "Usurper." Is that supposed to be an insult?

g.title: j1798592270
g.text: I'm just saying that it's kind of rich coming from you as an insult, when you're guilty of the same thing.

g.title: j3663180750
g.text: I'm just trying to figure out why you keep using it as a title for me.

g.title: j943120945
g.text: Ha! Hardly! You are extremely patient if you think I have been so casually insulting you to your face for days, now.

g.title: j3657424500
g.text: Well, that is what you are, yes? The Tenno usurped the Origin System from the Orokin. And you, like a little imposter in the nest, have stolen into this world from your own.

g.title: j1212746979
g.text: Ha! An insult? You are extremely patient if you think I have been so casually deriding you to your face for days, now.

g.title: j2246716640
g.text: And that makes you, on at least two counts, a Usurper by my measure. (And perhaps a third, if we count what the butler has told me of Duviri, but that is a debate for another time.)

g.title: j744805668
g.text: Because it is exactly that - a title. An honorific. You have accomplished that which I aspired to.

g.title: j2765530052
g.text: Particularly when it is so painfully clear you have so much power in this situation that is hardly unilateral, hm?

g.title: j370165158
g.text: Particularly when I know you could simply use your Void-given powers to step through a wall and put a few bullets into the back of my head anytime you wished.

g.title: j2288841282
g.text: Okay. So why keep using that as a title?

g.title: j1848587729
g.text: Particularly when it is so painfully clear you have so much power in this situation that is hardly unilateral, hm?

g.title: j739454335
g.text: Particularly when I know you could simply use your Void-given powers to step through a wall and put a few bullets into the back of my head anytime you wished.

g.title: j1017486018
g.text: The title is merely expression of my mild admiration. Even if it is one that is suitably sarcastic to suit my needs, yes, I will give you that.

g.title: j3641551631
g.text: I am not in the mood to make an enemy of you, Usurper. No. It is not an insult. It is only through your own lack of due diligence that you have not come to realize the large portion of my past that aligns with yours.

g.title: j2559396574
g.text: I am not in the mood to make an enemy of you, Usurper. No. If anything, it is an honorific. You have done that which I aspired to. Nothing more.

g.title: j1825395910
g.text: If I asked you nicely to call me something else, would you?

g.title: j2376425465
g.text: I was bent on overthrowing the Orokin, same as your child Tenno duplicate and their ilk. I was simply arrested from the timeline before I had my chance.

g.title: j710179165
g.text: Ha! I could almost hear the sigh from the Sanctum. Were they all like me? No. They were vastly inferior. And far more infuriating, I am afraid.

g.title: j2031251018
g.text: Hm... no. But I do appreciate the show of proper etiquette. You must earn your titles from me, Usurper. You know that.

g.title: j210375624
g.text: Good. You had no choice in the matter regardless.

g.title: j3420554777
g.text: Really, you make this too much fun.
